scope: Ki Blast Super evidence refresh after Batch 320; five existing partially verified records with direct current Xenoverse 2 evidence

records.name: Bloody Sauce
records.effect: Fires a wave of purple Ki blasts; vertical/horizontal patterns apply poison or a movement-speed slow, and close hits can apply both.
records.mechanics_notes: Current dedicated evidence lists 100 Ki and limits created-character use to Crystal Raid or Training mode; the move is otherwise associated with Supervillain/boss characters. It is not treated as a normal unrestricted CaC skill.

records.name: Burst Attack
records.unlock_method: Shenron wish: "I want a new Super Attack!"
records.effect: Fires a tracking flaming Ki Blast whose impact leaves a short-lived fire pillar and launches the opponent.
records.mechanics_notes: Current dedicated evidence reports a 100-Ki projectile, 5-hit explosive/launching behavior, and about 15% total damage. The documented acquisition is the Shenron new-Super-Attack wish rather than a PQ route.

records.name: Confusion Blade
records.effect: Creates suspended Ki spikes that can be redirected left or right and then home toward the opponent.
records.mechanics_notes: Current evidence reports a close-range opening hit followed by three tracking hits, with the initial and follow-up damage described separately. The skill remains a 100-Ki Ki Blast Super; no numeric drop probability is inferred from the Tokipedia reward presentation.

records.name: Consecutive Energy Blast
records.effect: Fires a tracking barrage of Ki blasts over a wide forward area.
records.mechanics_notes: Current dedicated evidence reports 10 projectiles/hits and about 10% total damage at the documented base cost. The maintained repository Skill Shop route is preserved without inventing a rotation, price, or progression threshold.

records.name: Crazy Finger Shot
records.character_source: Golden Frieza / Frieza (1st Form) Customize Partner
records.effect: Fires a thin finger beam; holding the input continues the barrage and consumes additional Ki.
records.mechanics_notes: Current dedicated evidence reports a 100-Ki base activation and up to 14 blasts, with continued firing consuming up to 800 Ki total and producing about 40% total damage. The PQ26 route is preserved; no unsupported Ultimate Finish gate or drop probability is asserted.

evidence_limits: Reward probabilities, shop prices/rotations, exact frame data, version-specific damage scaling, and narrower race/gender/form restrictions remain unresolved unless directly supported.
Historical/source conflicts remain preserved; current Xenoverse 2 acquisition evidence is not replaced by older Xenoverse-era wording.
No canonical skills.json or skills-index.json reconstruction/promotion is performed in this bounded research-only refresh.
